profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Trellis
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Engineer #3) — Stealth AI/FinTech Startup
positions.description:
Joined as Engineer #3 on an early-stage AI platform focused on document processing and workflow-driven systems supporting trading pipelines.

- Built core backend and product functionality across TypeScript, Node.js, Express, React, MongoDB, and AWS

- Implemented foundational workflows for AI-powered document ingestion, processing, enrichment, and downstream pricing flows

- Took ownership of major product areas, frequently acting as the first engineer on new features and platform components

- Led large feature builds and product refactors as the platform evolved from early prototype toward production readiness

- Operated cross-functionally with product and leadership to translate business requirements into shipped technical solutions

- Used Cursor IDE and Claude Code extensively as part of day-to-day development to accelerate implementation and iteration

- Developed deep domain knowledge of the system end-to-end, serving as a go-to engineer across backend services, data flows, and application logic

Tech Used: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, React, MongoDB, AWS, Cursor IDE, Claude Code
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Node.js · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · Cursor AI · Claude Code

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• API Development: Implemented REST API functionality for our Node with Typescript service, enhancing flexibility and efficiency in data retrieval.
• Enhanced Data Integrity: Identified and resolved caching issues in our DynamoDB production database, leading to near 100% success rates and eliminating data inconsistencies for clients.
• CICD Implementation: Established a dedicated development environment utilizing AWS Lambda, integrated it into our CI/CD pipeline, which reduced bugs by 30% and ensured QA stability.
• Log Management: Proactively resolved issues with application logs missing from Splunk and CloudWatch, leading investigations, configurations, and testing to ensure proper logging functionality.

Tech Used: Node.js, Typescript, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, Splunk, CloudWatch
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Amazon Dynamodb · Software Design · Node.js · TypeScript · Express.js · Gherkin · PostgreSQL · Splunk · Datadog · New Relic · PagerDuty · Java · Vue.js · Bogie

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Built and supported features for Candy’s payment processing system.
Worked full-stack in Golang, React, and PostgresSQL. Some of the highlights of my work include:
• Added customer support for crypto deposits which could be used to purchase NFTs.
• Created user transaction statements, helping reduce the computational load of balance calculations.
• Created and integrated internal custodial wallets for customers.
• Worked cross-functionally with the customer experience and fraud teams to address customer issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · REST APIs · TypeScript · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer - Walmart Labs
positions.description:
As part of the platform team supporting A/B experimentation at Walmart, I've been focused on bringing distributed tracing to Walmart with the use of OpenTelemetry APIs. The following is the bulk of my work:

•  Implemented a Node-based monkey patch for automatically forwarding experimentation headers to upstream services. This involved learning about NodeJS core and working with the Async Hooks library.
•  Implemented a Java-based header propagation library in Spring Boot using interceptors
•  Used these implementations to build a Proof of Concept to demonstrate how an ecosystem of services can have tracing headers automatically propagated throughout.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Jet
positions.description:
Before the Walmart integration, I was a part of the team that designed Jet’s version of Planout (Facebook’s A/B testing framework). This allowed me to take on responsibilities all across the tech stack including:

•  Implemented the UI for A/B testing at Jet in Angular4 which I then migrated over to React
•  Added Authentication in React and the Golang API using Azure’s OAuth2 implementation
•  Designed RESTful endpoints in Golang to support scheduling of experiments
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · REST APIs · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Developed core web components with open source technologies including, but not limited to, React.js, Redux, and Webpack to build web applications for the brands at NBCUniversal.

• Introduced a Webpack plugin for linting our SCSS stylesheets called stylelint.

• Detected poor performance in the web application by using Chromes DevTools (paint flashing, React Perf, etc.) and made changes where appropriate.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Assisted the engineering team transition its product from a desktop-based environment to a web-based environment utilizing ThingWorx (IoT) as the platform for creating the user interfaces.

• Developed functionality in JavaScript to retrieve and manipulate SQL data to be displayed on user interfaces.

positions.title: Edison Engineering Development Program
positions.description:
The Edison Engineering Development Program is an entry level rotational program with the purpose of preparing the future leaders of GE. We are offered leadership training, ability to obtain a master’s degree, and opportunities to work on 4 different teams with the goal of exposing us to different parts of the business. Below I highlight my work:

• Successfully implemented an HTML5-based application designed using the AngularJS framework. I managed the HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for the project. My work led to a minimum viable product (MVP) which was used to gather customer feedback.

• Researched and led the team’s pursuit of PowerShell user interface automation as the primary source for reducing testing hours from 400+ to below 200. I also used Microsoft UI Automation to automate our C# built applications. A process that once took 44 hours was brought down to 8 hours.

• Developed a new feature to support the ToolBoxST product. The feature was implemented in C# combined with WPF utilizing the Model-View-ViewModel (MVVM) design pattern. The project was well received by both customers and development teams.

• Gathered requirements and delivered the first release of a critical tool for automating customer reports. My work reduced the project life-cycle from 15 weeks to 11 weeks.
